QUOTE: By default every field is therefore named `private_<name>`. Code outside the library that writes `ctx->state` gets a compile error, and code that writes `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` compiles to `private_state`. The point is to make the internal layout unavailable to applications
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: It explains the name-mangling to `private_<name>` but never states that the fields remain visible and sized rather than hidden. It even says the aim is to make the "internal layout unavailable", which blurs the opacity-by-renaming point.
